title: A canonical morphism sends each element to a compatible formal glueing tuple
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings, phi:R→S any ring map, t a natural number and f:Fin(t)→R. Let M,N be R-modules [def-weil-module-base-change, def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away], and X,Y formal glueing data [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data] with the canonical prime, chart, comparison and swap components for M and N respectively, as bundled equalities and HEqs. Let z:X→Y be a morphism. Let p:S tensor_R M→S tensor_R N be S-linear and c_i:M_fi→N_fi be R-linear, identified by HEq with the prime and chart components of z. Put eta(n)=1 tensor n. Write eta_fi for its localized map, and rho_i,rho_j for the canonical maps into N_(fi*fj). Then for every m in M the tuple (p(1 tensor m),(c_i(m/1))_i) is in the kernel of beta, where beta(y,(s_i))=((y/1-eta_fi(s_i))_i,(rho_i(s_i)-rho_j(s_j))_(i,j)). No flatness or quotient-isomorphism hypothesis is required, and no existence of a preimage in N is asserted.

source.place: Remark 05EL, morphisms and the canonical functor; equation glueing-complex preceding Lemma 05EK. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05EL and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05EK because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Transport the prime and chart maps of z along the equalities identifying X and Y with canonical objects. Restriction of the canonical R_f-module chart gives its original R-module structure by algebraMap_smul. The supplied HEqs identify the transported maps with p and c_i, and the structural maps with compare and swap.

For m in M, evaluate prime compatibility at (1 tensor m)/1. The comparison formula sends this to 1 tensor (m/1), and base change of c_i sends that to 1 tensor c_i(m/1). The localized eta map on c_i(m/1) has the same image under comparison: this follows on n/1 from the comparison formula, and on every fraction from the localization universal property. Injectivity of compare therefore gives equality of the localized prime value and localized eta(c_i(m/1)). Every first component of beta vanishes.

Evaluate chart compatibility at (m/1)/1. The swap fixes this element, giving swap(n_i/1)=n_j/1, where n_i=c_i(m/1). Write n_i=x/f_i^a and n_j=y/f_j^b. The swap formula gives (x/1)/f_i^a=(y/f_j^b)/1. Clearing the outer denominator and then the inner denominator gives c,d with f_j^d f_i^c (f_j^b x-f_i^a y)=0 in N. In N_(fi*fj), the two canonical images have difference with numerator f_i^b f_j^a(f_j^b x-f_i^a y) and denominator (f_i*f_j)^(a+b). Multiplication by (f_i*f_j)^(c+d) annihilates the numerator, so the difference is zero. This proves every overlap component of beta vanishes without cancellation in N.

Extensionality of the product and of the two indexed families combines the zero component equations into beta(p(1 tensor m),(c_i(m/1))_i)=0. Empty indexed families and zero denominators are included by the same equations.

theorem canonical_tuple_compatible {R : Type u} {S : Type v}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → R)
    (M N : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R)
    (X Y : Data.{u, v, max u v w} φ f)
    (hX : X.M' = extend φ M ∧
      (∀ i, X.M i = ModuleCat.of (Localization.Away (f i))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (f i) M)) ∧
      (∀ i, HEq (X.alpha i).toLinearMap (compare φ (f i) M)) ∧
      (∀ i j, HEq (X.alpha_overlap i j).toLinearMap (swap (f i) (f j) M)))
    (hY : Y.M' = extend φ N ∧
      (∀ i, Y.M i = ModuleCat.of (Localization.Away (f i))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (f i) N)) ∧
      (∀ i, HEq (Y.alpha i).toLinearMap (compare φ (f i) N)) ∧
      (∀ i j, HEq (Y.alpha_overlap i j).toLinearMap (swap (f i) (f j) N)))
    (z : X ⟶ Y)
    (p : extend φ M →ₗ[S] extend φ N)
    (c : ∀ i, localize (f i) M →ₗ[R] localize (f i) N)
    (hp : HEq z.prime p) (hc : ∀ i, HEq (z.chart i) (c i)) :
    letI : Algebra R S := φ.toAlgebra
    let η : N →ₗ[R] S ⊗[R] N := TensorProduct.mk R S N 1
    let ρ := fun (a h : R) (ha : a ∣ h) ↦
      IsLocalizedModule.lift (Submonoid.powers a)
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers a) N)
        (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers h) N)
        (RingTheory.localizationAway_map_units_of_dvd (M := N) a h ha)
    let β : (S ⊗[R] N) × (∀ i : Fin t, LocalizedModule.Away (f i) N) →
        (∀ i : Fin t, LocalizedModule.Away (f i) (S ⊗[R] N)) ×
          (∀ i j : Fin t, LocalizedModule.Away (f i * f j) N) :=
      fun q ↦
        (fun i ↦ LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (f i)) (S ⊗[R] N) q.1 -
          IsLocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers (f i))
            (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (f i)) N)
            (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (f i)) (S ⊗[R] N)) η (q.2 i),
         fun i j ↦ ρ (f i) (f i * f j) (dvd_mul_right (f i) (f j)) (q.2 i) -
          ρ (f j) (f i * f j) (dvd_mul_left (f j) (f i)) (q.2 j))
    ∀ m : M, β (p ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m), fun i ↦ c i (LocalizedModule.mk m 1)) = 0
